references.text: The preceding verses provide the context for the fifth-year rule, where the fruit of fruit trees was to remain uncircumcised for three years and holy to the Lord in the fourth year
The firstfruits of the harvest were to be brought to the Lord as a thank offering, reflecting the principle that God blesses the harvest when His people honor Him with the firstfruits
The promise that God will bless and increase the harvest when one honors Him with their firstfruits and tithes
The description of the good land with fruit trees and the promise of blessing, along with the reminder to bless the Lord for the good land
The promise of abundant harvest and fertility as a result of obedience to the Lord's commands
The blessing over the produce of the earth and fruit trees as a consequence of obedience to the Lord
The formula 'I am the Lord your God' is used to emphasize God's authority behind the commandments and the call to holiness
